[SWS_DM_01085] Triggering for snapshot record storage (configured, without update)
⌈
If DiagnosticMemoryDestination.typeOfFreezeFrameRe-
cordNumeration is set to configured, DiagnosticFreezeFrame.update is set
to ’False’, the configured DiagnosticFreezeFrame.trigger is fulfilled and the
snapshot is not yet stored, the DM shall collect and store the snapshot record.
⌋
